capabilities: Toggle a zen mode that hides sidebars, frontmatter, tab bar, status bar and other UI
Switch to a different installed theme while zen mode is on
Fade non-active lines and darken screen edges while writing
Enter reading mode and optionally lock editing during zen mode
Configure line width, font size and toolbar hiding from settings
extras: Uses undocumented Obsidian internals to switch themes and change app settings, and stores original values in local storage so they are restored after a crash.
problem: Obsidian exposes many interface elements around the editor, and reading or writing without them requires manually hiding sidebars, status bar, tabs and frontmatter each time.
summary: Distraction-free zen mode that hides sidebars, properties, tab bar, status bar and other UI, with a floating button to exit.
